name: select-20
description: Inline small role selects for each member in a team management list.

files.content:
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, } from "@workspace/ui/components/select" const roles = [ { label: "Owner", value: "owner" }, { label: "Admin", value: "admin" }, { label: "Editor", value: "editor" }, { label: "Viewer", value: "viewer" }, ] const members = [ { name: "Ali Imam", email: "ali@designali.com", role: "owner" }, { name: "Sam", email: "sam@designali.com", role: "admin" }, { name: "Iris", email: "iris@designali.com", role: "editor" }, { name: "Theo", email: "theo@designali.com", role: "viewer" }, ] export default function TeamRoleSelect() { return (
{members.map((member) => (
{member.name .split(" ") .map((part) => part[0]) .join("")}
{member.name} {member.email}
))}
) }
